en: Oh, it's you, from the Pokémon Center! Excuse the mess. I'm always tinkering with the storage system.
Keep your boxes tidy and give each one a name. You'll always know where everyone is!
It's Lanette's research notebook. Read it?
"The storage system turns a Pokémon into data, so that it can be kept safely in a PC."
There's more on the next page. Keep reading?
"Anyone can use it from any Pokémon Center's PC. That was the hardest part to make work."
